before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data and sum revenue across regions for each month
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('month')
monthly['running_revenue'] = monthly['revenue'].cumsum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['running_revenue'], marker='o')
ax.set_title('Running Total of Revenue Across Months')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Running revenue')
ax.set_ylim(0, monthly['running_revenue'].max() * 1.05)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
